items.title: Nim version 2.4.0 released
items.blurb: The Nim programming language is a concise, fast programming language that compiles to C, C++ and JavaScript.

items.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports September 2026 Monthly Recommended Patch
items.blurb: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for Oracle now supports the September 2026 Monthly Recommended Patch (MRP) for Oracle Database version 19c and 26ai.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore CLI version 1.0 is now available
items.blurb: AWS announces the general availability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore CLI version 1.0 (@aws/agentcore 1.0.0), rebuilt with faster startup, a consistent command structure, and support for more AgentCore resources.

items.title: AWS Lambda supports Seekable OCI (SOCI) lazy loading for Lambda Managed Instances
items.blurb: AWS Lambda now supports Seekable OCI (SOCI) for lazy loading Event Functions packaged as Open Container Initiative (OCI) images running on Lambda Managed Instances .

items.title: Introducing time series collections for the next generation of Amazon OpenSearch Serverless
items.blurb: Today, we're announcing support for time series collections on the next generation of Amazon OpenSearch Serverless.

items.title: Quick now supports smart approvals for agentic actions
items.blurb: Amazon Quick now supports smart approvals, a review layer that reduces unnecessary approval prompts while preserving human oversight of the actions that matter most.

items.title: Amazon EKS Dashboard now provides fleet-wide visibility into certificate authority (CA) rotation
items.blurb: Today, Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) announces certificate authority (CA) rotation visibility in the Amazon EKS Dashboard, giving you a consolidated view of CA rotation across your clusters.

items.title: Datadog Builds a Specialist AI Model for SRE Investigations
items.blurb: Datadog has released Scout, a model trained to investigate production problems. It runs inside Bits Investigation, the company's AI SRE product, where it can pick up an alert, look through telemetry and suggest what caused the problem.
